Mouse step 5 → 6 updates real host screen; exact versioned event
Previous and Next use adjacent steps and boundary buttons disable
Keyboard arrows/Home/End, Enter and Space navigate; focus survives host updates
All six steps remain visible when unavailable; restricted and busy block navigation
Current step emits nothing; state is controlled until host accepts
Invalid input properties are rejected atomically, with defensive copies
Attributes update valid state, invalid values retain prior state and emit errors
Repeated mount/unmount has one listener; instances have independent state
Duplicate module import does not redefine custom element; pre-upgrade property retained
Demo copy log and reset controls work
Compact navigation keeps all six labels and supports hiding duplicate controls
No external service requests, failed requests or relevant browser errors

limitations: Standalone C01 only; full application shell not implemented
Chromium only; Firefox and Safari untested
